summary.text: Julius Soti is the incumbent Republican candidate for the New Hampshire House of Representatives, Rockingham 35, in the November 3, 2026 general election. Ballotpedia lists his tenure in the House as beginning in 2020, and he is a business owner.

paragraphs.text: Soti graduated from Garfield High School in 1985 and earned a B.A. in philosophy and history from William Paterson University.
His career experience includes owning J.F.Soti Management and working as a senior probation officer with the State of New Jersey and as a substitute teacher.
He has served as the vice chair of the Windham Republican Town Committee and the vice president of the American Hungarian Citizens League.
